(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly implements national-scale (Belgium) spatial downscaling of future land use projections using the GLOBIO model. Its primary objective is to produce high-resolution (10 m and 100 m) LULC projections from coarse global data (LUH2). It implements and quantitatively compares three distinct SSP-RCP scenarios (SSP1xRCP2.6, SSP3xRCP6.0, SSP5xRCP8.5). The study reports quantitative accuracy metrics (RSR, overall accuracy, Kappa) and validates results against independent datasets. Outputs include mapped LULC projections at national scale. All core inclusion criteria are met, and none of the exclusion criteria apply.)
